We e… [/about] About Us From Humble Beginnings to Global Beauty The story behind Bayport Laboratories About Us From Humble Beginnings to Global Beauty Skip to content The story behind Bayport Laboratories From Humble Beginnings to Beauty Industry Leaders Dedication, resilience, and determination Our Founder’s Journey In their early twenties, Angle and Yaumara made the courageous decision to leave Cuba and build a new life in America. Armed with Angle’s Chemical Engineering degree from University of Matanzas and Yaumara’s medical training from Villa Clara School of Medicine, they arrived with expertise but had to rebuild everything else from scratch. Angle’s early career at Estee Lauder became the foundation that would shape Bayport’s scientific approach, while Yaumara continued her education, earning her Biochemistry credentials at Rutgers and ultimately graduating Summa Cum Laude with her Doctor of Pharmacy degree from Arnold & Marie College. If not for their unwavering dedication, resilience, and the helping hands of kind souls in the beauty industry, Bayport Laboratories wouldn’t exist today. But their struggle became their strength. By 2010, they had transformed their hard-won experience into a company that now employs over 200 people from intersectional backgrounds and interdisciplinary passions from all over the world. They’ve made the cosmetic world their home with the same love that pushed them through their darkest moments—and that same passionate dedication flows through every formulation we create. “We understand what it means to build something from nothing; to fight for a dream.
